mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS access_count, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS unique_visitors, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id) AS active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id) FILTER (WHERE ) AS actual_users FROM audit_event WHERE actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR actor_user_id = #{userId})

WITH days AS ( SELECT generated.day::date AS activity_day FROM generate_series( CAST(#{period.fromDate} AS timestamp without time zone), CAST(#{period.toDateExclusive} AS timestamp without time zone) - interval '1 day', interval '1 day' ) AS generated(day) ), activity AS (
SELECT activity_day, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS access_count, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS unique_visitors, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id) AS active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id) FILTER (WHERE ) AS actual_users FROM ( SELECT (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date AS activity_day, e.event_type, e.actor_user_id FROM audit_event e WHERE e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{userId}) ) local_event GROUP BY activity_day ), accounts AS ( SELECT activity_day, COUNT(*) AS new_accounts FROM ( SELECT (u.created_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date AS activity_day FROM user_account u WHERE u.created_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND u.created_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR u.id = #{userId}) ) local_account GROUP BY activity_day ) SELECT days.activity_day, COALESCE(activity.access_count, 0) AS access_count, COALESCE(activity.unique_visitors, 0) AS unique_visitors, COALESCE(activity.active_users, 0) AS active_users, COALESCE(activity.actual_users, 0) AS actual_users, COALESCE(accounts.new_accounts, 0) AS new_accounts FROM days LEFT JOIN activity USING (activity_day) LEFT JOIN accounts USING (activity_day) ORDER BY days.activity_day

WITH hours AS (SELECT generate_series(0, 23) AS hour) SELECT hours.hour, COUNT(e.id) AS operation_count FROM hours LEFT JOIN audit_event e ON EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text)))::integer = hours.hour AND e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.event_type IN ('OPTIMIZATION_SUBMITTED', 'PLAN_CREATED', 'CONTEXT_PREPARED', 'CONTEXT_ANALYZED', 'RESULT_EXPORTED', 'RECHARGE_PAID') AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY hours.hour ORDER BY hours.hour

WITH months AS ( SELECT generated.month_start FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', CAST(#{period.fromDate} AS date)), date_trunc('month', CAST(#{toDateLast} AS date)), interval '1 month') AS generated(month_start) ), activity AS ( SELECT month_start, COUNT(*) AS operation_count FROM ( SELECT date_trunc('month', e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text)) AS month_start FROM audit_event e WHERE e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.event_type IN ('OPTIMIZATION_SUBMITTED', 'PLAN_CREATED', 'CONTEXT_PREPARED', 'CONTEXT_ANALYZED', 'RESULT_EXPORTED', 'RECHARGE_PAID') AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{userId}) ) local_event GROUP BY month_start ) SELECT to_char(months.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(activity.operation_count, 0) AS operation_count FROM months LEFT JOIN activity USING (month_start) ORDER BY months.month_start

SELECT COALESCE(e.details->>'deviceType', 'UNKNOWN') AS device_type, COUNT(*) AS login_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.actor_user_id) AS unique_users FROM audit_event e WHERE e.event_type = 'LOGIN' AND e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY COALESCE(e.details->>'deviceType', 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY login_count DESC, device_type

SELECT e.actor_user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(u.display_name, '') AS display_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type IN ('OPTIMIZATION_SUBMITTED', 'PLAN_CREATED', 'CONTEXT_PREPARED', 'CONTEXT_ANALYZED', 'RESULT_EXPORTED', 'RECHARGE_PAID')) AS operation_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'LOGIN') AS login_count, COUNT(DISTINCT (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date) AS active_days FROM audit_event e LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.id = e.actor_user_id WHERE e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (e.event_type IN ('OPTIMIZATION_SUBMITTED', 'PLAN_CREATED', 'CONTEXT_PREPARED', 'CONTEXT_ANALYZED', 'RESULT_EXPORTED', 'RECHARGE_PAID') OR e.event_type = 'LOGIN') AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY e.actor_user_id, u.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type IN ('OPTIMIZATION_SUBMITTED', 'PLAN_CREATED', 'CONTEXT_PREPARED', 'CONTEXT_ANALYZED', 'RESULT_EXPORTED', 'RECHARGE_PAID')) > 0 ORDER BY operation_count DESC, login_count DESC, e.actor_user_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.actor_user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(u.display_name, '') AS display_name, e.event_type, e.occurred_at, e.details->>'clientIp' AS client_ip, e.details->>'country' AS country, e.details->>'province' AS province, e.details->>'city' AS city, e.details->>'loginCountry' AS login_country, e.details->>'loginProvince' AS login_province, e.details->>'loginCity' AS login_city, COALESCE(e.details->>'deviceType', 'UNKNOWN') AS device_type FROM audit_event e LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.id = e.actor_user_id WHERE e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.occurred_at >= #{fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{userId}) AND (CAST(#{eventType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text) IS NULL OR e.event_type = #{eventType}) ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id
